concept: An avatar is a portrait behind a lens. A rim of light runs along its top and shade gathers at its foot, and the large size rests on a soft shadow, so the face sits on the glass like a small object.

root.why: a round portrait, the shape of something held

sm.why: 30px for dense rows of people, such as a list of replies

md.why: 44px for lists and headers, where the face has to be recognised

lg.why: 84px on a profile, resting on a soft shadow

img.why: the photo covers the circle edge to edge

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours drop the lens, so a real system-colour border keeps the shape

default_to_avoid.pattern: a flat circle avatar crop with a white ring (every social app)
default_to_avoid.why_not: the flat crop is a hole punched in the glass and the white ring is a sticker edge; neither says the portrait sits on the pane

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip
derivation.form: the portrait carries a rim of light at its top and the large size rests on a soft shadow

derivation.consequence: the rim and sheen are white at low opacity, like light catching an edge
derivation.form: the rim is white at low opacity, never a solid white ring

derivation.consequence: legibility comes from dimming and blurring the backdrop (brightness, blur) inside a smoked body thick enough that a pane reads as a slab of glass, with the scene softened behind it
derivation.form: shade at the foot of the lens comes from dimming, not from a dark border

derivation.consequence: controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: the portrait stays round, the shape of something held

variants.reason: A gives the portrait the pane's own light (P3 depth and colour) without adding a ring. B is a different shape language from the rest of Pane. C puts the face in a hole, which reads as a placeholder slot more than a person.
